programme.desc: In this epic action-thriller starring Andy Lau & Louis Koo, a bounty of USD $100 million awaits those who successfully capture the biggest drug dealer in Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Ex-Files 4: Marriage Plan
programme.desc: Two brothers, Yun and Fei, face challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, and Fei and his girlfriend opt for a 'marriage cooling-off period' to tackle marriage issues.

programme.title: The Sleep Curse
programme.desc: After two cult classic films from the 90s - director Herman Yau & Anthony Wong reunite, and together with Gordon Lam, Michelle Wai & Jojo Goh, challenge your limit in this paranormal thriller.

programme.title: Song of Spring
programme.desc: This is a touching story about an 85-year-old mother caring for her 65-year-old daughter with Alzheimer's disease.

programme.title: Stuntman
programme.desc: A washed-up stunt director is struggling to find his way in the changing film industry. He risks everything to make a comeback, while striving to mend his relationship with his estranged daughter.

programme.title: Demi-Haunted
programme.desc: Starring Eason Chan, Joey Yung & Nicholas Tse, this dark comedy depicts the spirit of a Chinese opera singer who returns to perform a final song for her lover.

programme.title: Love Lies
programme.desc: Gynaecologist Veronica falls for an online dating app scam with young Joe, who poses as a French engineer. What begins as a romance built on lies ultimately transforms two seemingly mismatched souls.

programme.title: The White Storm 3: Heaven or Hell
programme.desc: Two undercover cops successfully develop a brotherly bond with a Thai drug lord. When the police busts the syndicate, the drug lord discovers that there is betrayal within his circle of trust...

programme.title: All's Well End's Well 2009
programme.desc: Yu Chu is brilliant but impossible to date. Her brother hires love expert Dick to woo her and break a curse but Yu Chu falls for him fast and won't let Dick go without a fight.

programme.title: A Legend
programme.desc: An archaeologist uncovers artifacts from a glacier expedition that resembles a jade pendant in his dream, so he leads his team to a fantastical adventure into the glacier to unveil the truth.

programme.title: Welcome To My Side
programme.desc: After a breakup and an accident, Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks. It is only when he meets Jia Nan that her presence chases them away and sparks an absurd yet sweet romance.

programme.title: Pavane For An Infant
programme.desc: A baby hatch that never closes faces moral backlash. Nevertheless, Lai Sum, Fatimah, Kam Jie, and Nuru remain committed to helping desperate mothers and abandoned newborns.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: An imperial guard and his three traitorous friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later, they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fong and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Incredible
programme.desc: Bored with their mundane country lifestyle, a retired superhero couple sets out to make a comeback at the upcoming Martial World Assembly.

programme.title: Ready o/r Knot
programme.desc: A couple who first meet at a wedding & have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the 'next step.'?

programme.title: Dragon Tiger Gate
programme.desc: Tiger Wong is ambushed after taking the Lousha Plaque, but is saved by his brother and also befriends Turbo Shek. To avenge the death of Dragon Gate masters, the trio vow to defeat Lousha Clan leader.

programme.title: Once in a Blue Moon
programme.desc: Mei Zhen's family appears to get along but harbours secrets - she struggles at work, her brother hides his separation and their mother fears her past will affect them. Can they overcome these hurdles?

programme.title: 72 Tenants of Prosperity
programme.desc: Two sworn brothers become enemies after the girl they love marries one of them. The rivalry is only resolved when the property owner of their shops wants to terminate their tenancies 40 years later.

programme.title: Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: When a school bus driver is injured after risking his life to save a boy during an accident, the boy's father invites him to live with them. However, disturbing facts soon begin to emerge.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A family running a Chinese dessert shop faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. This heartfelt journey reveals the strength of family bonds, sacrifices, and resilience.

programme.title: Behind the Shadows
programme.desc: A private detective uncovers his wife's betrayal during a case. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case, only to find the subject murdered, and revealing a string of serial killings.

programme.title: Victim(s)
programme.desc: After a ruthless Kuala Lumpur student murders his classmate, the victim's mother and the killer's mother uncover hidden truths about their sons and face very different paths of grief and torment.

programme.title: Wild City
programme.desc: Hong Kong director Ringo Lam returns after seven years with this action drama in which a cop-turned-bar-owner & his brother are pulled into a gang war.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. Inspired by the respected Master Wen, Sheng gradually changes his attitude towards his career and life.

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit
programme.desc: Three devastated parents unite after their children are abducted. Driven by grief and rage, they hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate to bring their children home alive.

programme.title: Dead Talents Society
programme.desc: Newbie ghost Rookie must prove herself in the afterlife by delivering spectacular scares. A washed-up ghost diva and her agent help her battle to earn her haunting licence, or else she will vanish.

programme.title: A Murder Erased
programme.desc: Police officer Choi is assigned to a case where the body was undiscovered for 8 years. During the investigation, the prosecutor finds all inconsistencies & suspicions fall on Choi.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: After being discovered flirting with his boss' daughter, Sing gets blown up, but later gets relived as his professor transforms him to be a cyborg of household products.

programme.title: The Brotherhood of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his friend Meow flee after Meow's attempt to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, their paths cross when Meow's life is in danger again. Will Chai choose loyalty over duty?

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress.

programme.title: Coffin Homes
programme.desc: Three tales merges in this satire set against Hong Kong's housing crisis, where soaring property prices have driven people to desperate measures - including sharing a space with the dead!

programme.title: Guilt By Design
programme.desc: As a juror in a high-profile case learns that his daughter has been mysteriously kidnapped, he must decide whether to use his special skills to influence the trial as demanded by the kidnappers.

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: After years of self-neglect, Le Ying decides to embrace life anew. Meeting a boxing coach sparks her desire for a fresh start. Despite the challenges ahead, she embarks on a transformative journey.

programme.title: Echoes of the Thunder
programme.desc: Nam and Fire are top racing drivers. Nam is depressed after causing a young racing driver's injury. Fire decides to compete in an illegal street car race to stand up for Nam. Can he succeed finally?

programme.title: True Love For Once In My Life
programme.desc: Sabrina's deep love for Andrew is shattered by his affair which ends their marriage. Years later, she returns to care for him as he is diagnosed with cancer, believing that true love comes only once.

programme.title: Marriage with a Liar
programme.desc: Kiki and Sean, who have been together for seven years, betray each other three days before their wedding. Faced with 'perfect' partners, they abandon their responsibilities and part ways.

programme.title: Good Game
programme.desc: A desperate internet cafe owner recruits his daughter, a washed-up action star and a failed pro gamer to form a ragtag esports team—all for a HK$500k tournament and one last, no-regrets shot.

programme.title: Invincible Swordsman
programme.desc: Linghu Chong wishes to leave the martial world but gets drawn into a violent feud. He falls for Dongfang Bubai, but a tragic misunderstanding leads to a fatal showdown.

programme.title: Break Up Club
programme.desc: Jaycee Chan plays a 20-something slacker who discovers a magical website that may help reunite him and his girlfriend but at what cost?

programme.title: Detrimental

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Chan plays Eddie Yang, a Hong Kong cop who is working with Interpol officer Arthur Watson in order to protect a gifted young child.

programme.title: July Rhapsody

programme.title: Mad Fate

programme.title: I Want to Be Rich

programme.title: Invincible Swordsman

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: In this masterpiece from Li Han Hsiang, sparks fly when minister Cheng Pu decides to marry off his youngest daughter before his eldest one.

programme.title: The Lady Is the Boss
programme.desc: A martial arts sifu and a hip marketing wiz have to overlook their differences to outsmart gangsters who are trying to take them down.

programme.title: The Sword and the Lute
programme.desc: Kwei Wu and his partner go on a mission to destroy the Phoenix Lute, a deadly weapon that shoots poisonous needles and can only be destroyed by the Kan sword.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Three single females and the men they fall for think things are simple and blissful until the lasses' parents enter into the picture.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: A woman sets up a troubled love triangle involving 2 swordsmen (Ti Lung and Lau Wing) and an enchanting lady (Ching Li).

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A young woman, who has gone through life disguised as a boy, must deal with her family's pressure for her to marry and the love of another woman.

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: This actioner revolves around the conflicts of kung fu masters. Complications further ensue when one of them falls for a princess.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: A young rebel goes into legend after being reincarnated to save his people from their tyrannical emperor.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Alongside the equally famous Lo Lieh, superstar David Chiang plays noble warrior monk Chih Shim, the monk who saved the Southern Shaolin Temple.

programme.title: Usurpers of Emperor's Power
programme.desc: When Prince Li of the Sung Dynasty is exiled with his lovely wife and faithful warrior, Li Lan, he later commits suicide. Now, it is up to Li Lan to avenge him.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Chiang Li Ping plays a scorned wife, while Elaine Chin Yen Ling is the mistress who teaches the hypocritical husband that what goes around, comes around.

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In this unofficial third sequel to The 36th Chamber of Shaolin, San Te (Gordon Liu) is given the task of training Fong Sai Yuk.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Catch superstar, Linda Lin Dai, in one of her most acclaimed roles in this story of forbidden love between a country maiden and the emperor.

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: The old and the new were mixed together to create a far-out period action love story.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: After a compulsive gambler's wife leaves him, he gets offered a beautiful ghost as his new wife.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A trio of heroes go up against a power-hungry Ming Dynasty official and also cross paths with three beauties.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: A stunning snake goddess in human form seduces a young scholar before a Buddhist monk breaks up their union.

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: A wine shop owner's son, who finds a brilliant martial arts coach in his private tutor, foils a plan by a thief but what happens when he returns for revenge?

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays a beauty tricked into sacrificing herself for the good of the Chinese people. However, the truth is revealed too late.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Sparks fly when a female doctor criticizes a fashion designer's creations, but love follows regardless.

programme.title: The Emperor and His Brother
programme.desc: This epic depicts how Chen Chia Lo and his men set out to persuade the Qing Emperor Chien Lung to acknowledge his Han bloodline and join the anti-Qing movement.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The film's curious title refers to two props that signal a happy beginning to what develops into a tragic love story, linking a scholar and a local beauty.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: From writer director Pan Lei comes this Chinese variation of Henry King's famous 1950's film about a persecuted swordsman.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Based on the folk legend, director Li Han Hsiang presents this humorous portrayal of the Emperor Chien Lung's adventures in Jiang Nan.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The 'iron triangle' comprising director Chang Cheh and stars David Chiang and Ti Lung produces this explosive kung fu epic.

programme.title: Sweet and Wild
programme.desc: With a twisted plot, mistaken identities, along with some terrific musical numbers, this comedy of errors featuring Li Ching is absolutely fabulous.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: In one of her first roles, 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon' villain Cheng Pei Pei plays a kung-fu Nancy Drew who must face a secret serial killer.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this sequel, the Mad Monk is joined by immortal scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin, as they both wreak havoc in an attempt to outdo each other!

programme.title: Heads for Sale
programme.desc: Chiao Chiao stars in the popular tale of a decapitating swordswoman who will let nothing stand in her way when she falls in love with a bandit's son.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: One of the most enjoyable musicals to grace the Hong Kong screen, this classic stars the husband-and-wife team of Peter Chen and Betty Loh.

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Watch as rival kung-fu schools try to sabotage Fei-hung's superior Pao Chih Lin clinic until the chivalrous philanthropist shows them the error of their ways.

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: The 'Venoms' bid a fond farewell to their internationally beloved film series with this saga about a building that bristles with booby-trapped blades.

programme.title: The Mighty One
programme.desc: The famed Ivy Ling Po plays a mysterious swordswoman, who teams up with the Roving Knight in a battle against a string of intimidating villains.

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: A brother and sister use the mythical yin/yang Holy Flame kung-fu technique when they seek vengeance for their dead parents.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Adapted from Chiung Yao's novel, this romance depicts how a wealthy man and a sweet girl discover that they are soulmates too late in life.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: It's Shaolin versus corrupt Ching soldiers in Chang Cheh's fun-filled kung-fu showcase, filled with show-stopping martial arts sequences.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: In this chapter of the 'Journey to the West' saga, the Monkey King and his gang are confronted by a whole host of fanciful villains.

programme.title: Opium and the Kung-Fu Master
programme.desc: Legendary kung fu choreographer Tang Chia's last work is one of the greatest ever, and one of Shaw Brothers' finest movies ever produced.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: A man is arrested after every woman he had sexual trysts with ends up dead shortly afterwards but the murders continue.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: Superstar Cheng Pei-pei stars as Yen Lai, the one woman who can reunite the Kao brothers in a bid to save the Teng Lung Manor and avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: Starring Kara Hui, Yuen Tak and Meng Yuen Man, this film depicts a series of battles as everyone fights over the 'Yuan Yang Swords', which hold the secrets to Kung Fu.

programme.title: The Master of Kung Fu
programme.desc: In this action-packed experimental piece, an all-too-human Huang Fei-hung battles a gangster's plan to frame him for robbery and murder.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: Jealousy threatens to expose the secret relationship of a 17-year-old student and her 35-year-old teacher husband.

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: Director Ho Meng-hua presents an all-star cast in this searing martial arts extravaganza that will bewitch you with its swift swordplay.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: An insane swordsman takes to making Chinese lamps from the skin of his enemies' sisters, mistresses and wives!

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Director Chang Cheh teams up with the Five Venoms in this martial arts saga that captures the fab five at their swashbuckling best.

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Two rebel Shaolin warriors embark on a deadly secret mission aimed at bringing down the Ching Dynasty. Starring Lo Meng, Chin Siu Ho.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: After an inn-keeper's daughter witnesses a perverted rape, her true love must rescue her from the greater danger that threatens.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu, who is trying to shed his criminal side, instead finds himself caught up in an all-out gang war that comes to a startling conclusion.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: After a kung-fu master (Lau Kar Leung) is crippled by a ruthless villain, he teaches a boy monkey kung-fu to avenge his shame.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: To save his son from being killed, the head of the Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends his son to be hidden by a master fighter. Will the boy prove a hero?

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei stars as Hsiao-Yun, a young singer struggling to juggle her career and her relationship with her pianist lover.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: In veteran writer/ director Yueh Feng's most memorable martial arts movies, the luminous and lethal Shih Szu plays the title swordswoman.

programme.title: Sons of Good Earth
programme.desc: This multiple award-winning film is King Hu's first solo production, a tale of the Sino-Japanese War that ends in artistic and emotional triumph.

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: A Shaw kung fu classic from 1984, this film depicts the trials of a young hero who sets out to avenge his parents' death.

programme.title: Inside the Forbidden City
programme.desc: This film marks the Shaw Brothers' quintessential 'Huangmei Opera' costume drama, with a superb performance from Ivy Ling Po and Chin Feng.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: In this 'Flying Guillotine' follow-up, a fearless woman (Chen Ping) takes on a flying guillotine gang even while she's pregnant!

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Two ingenious lovebirds come up with what they think is a fool proof plan to get their parents to allow them to wed. Starring Ching Li.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: This entertaining 'Robin Hood' epic features a hero who steals from the thieves and gives to the poor which sets the thieves on the warpath.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: In true Huangmei opera style, lovely Li Hsiang-chun stars as a used and abused beauty in director Kao Li's restrained, as well as sadistic tearjerker.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: This epic classic charts a romance between two teenage cousins, who pursue their relationship despite objections from their respective families.

programme.title: Angel With the Iron Fists
programme.desc: After her father is killed by gangsters, a young woman seeks revenge plus bids to ensure that justice is served. Starring Lily Ho.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: After a guilty Alex confesses his affair to Tung, his injured wife, she somehow ends up living with Alex's mother and his mistress under the same roof!

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: At first, a gang just wants the village locksmith to open a stolen safe, but it soon escalates into wholesale torment when they are met with resistance.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: The court intrigues, politicking, bickering and backstabbing continues in this sequel to The Empress Dowager. Starring Lisa Lu.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: A woman sets up a troubled love triangle involving 2 swordsmen (Ti Lung and Lau Wing) and an enchanting lady (Ching Li).

programme.title: The Crimson Palm

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: Veteran Yueh Feng made this 'Martial Arts World' saga of a masked master of the 'Black Sand Hand Technique,' starring Lily Ho in a dual role.

programme.title: The Bride From Hell
programme.desc: After a bride-to-be is discovered to be possessed, justice must be done and an exorcism performed before anyone can rest in peace.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman

programme.title: Love With the Perfect Stranger

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: Share the exploits of two con men vying for a horde of hidden gold. In addition to the mix is a Shaolin monk and his dangerous mute sister!

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: A cruel uncle stands in the way between a young scholar and the beautiful gal with whom he falls in love, and happiness.

programme.title: Hex After Hex

programme.title: Family Light Affair

programme.title: The Twin Swords

programme.title: A Deadly Secret

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing

programme.title: Perils of the Sentimental Swordsman

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman

programme.title: Spring Blossoms

programme.title: Gang Master

programme.desc: A nobleman who has passed the national civil service exam meets the self-proclaimed best chef in Joseon, falls into the world of gourmet food, and sets out to find the life he truly wants.

programme.title: Cassiopeia
programme.desc: Soo-Jin is a successful lawyer and loving mother who tries to live a fulfilling life after her divorce, but things start to fall apart when she is diagnosed with Alzheimer's after a car accident.

programme.title: My Daughter Is a Zombie
programme.desc: Jung-hwan's daughter, Soo-ah, is infected with a zombie virus. He notices that she still seems to understand words, so he draws on his experience with animal training to guide his zombie daughter.

programme.title: TAEYONG: Ty Track in Cinemas

programme.title: Noryang: Deadly Sea

programme.title: Bottom of the Water

programme.title: Love Reset
